newsitem.title: USA: Former Prudential employees interviewed - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Former Prudential employees interviewed - WSJ.

text.p: Former Prudential Insurance Co of America employees have been interviewed by federal investigators about potential obstruction of justice connected to suits alleging sales fraud, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Thursday's electronic edition, the newspaper attributed the information to the lawyers for several of those interviewed and others familiar with the case.
The Wall Street Journal said it was not clear how far the investigation, which took place over the past two months, had progressed or whether it was still continuing.
The probe stemmed from the recent massive class-action suits accusing Prudential of misleading practices in life insurance sales, the story said.
Prudential could end up paying more than $2.5 billion to policy-holders to settle class-action lawsuits alleging that the company engaged in deceptive sales practices.
